command: dotnet-trace collect --profile dotnet-sampled-thread-time --output si-hilbert-8b8daab1.nettrace -- dotnet OoplesFinance.StockIndicators.CompetitorBenchmarks.dll --profile-hilbert TaLib.Functions.HtDcPeriod 10000 500
scope: Unprivileged Windows sampled thread time. Includes fixture setup, independent references, device initialization, 100 warmup builds and 500 measured-loop builds. Percentages include waiting threads; they are not CPU utilization or an isolated steady-state profile.
interpretation: The FIR and other exact arithmetic stages plus history copying are optimization candidates. Inlined arithmetic may be attributed to Append; its samples cannot be identified solely as dispatch overhead. No speedup follows from these percentages.
